title: Cl-, Pl-, Fl- to Ll-
label: ch:sound-cluster-ll
canDo: I can try three Latin clusters on an unfamiliar ll- word and find the English cousin.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C57-ll: name llamar's cousins, give the three clusters, and decode llave.
payoff.note: Three starting points, one destination -- untidy, and useful because of it: an unfamiliar ll- word gives the reader three English shapes to try. Also names what all three sound laws share: Spanish inherited and eroded, English borrowed later and stayed nearer the Latin.
